title: Match the Kitchen Window Light
tests: Tests physically consistent relighting and cast shadows during background replacement, including transparent glass edges.

faults.what: The long cast shadow extends toward the lower left instead of the requested lower right, and the strongest glass highlights suggest sunlight from the upper right rather than the upper left.

judge.summary: The candle is convincingly placed on a pale kitchen counter, but the sunlight and cast shadow run in the wrong direction.

must_haves.item: The same candle jar and wax are preserved on a pale kitchen counter.
must_haves.why: The jar shape, threaded rim, cream wax, and upright wick remain recognizable and closely match the original.

must_haves.item: The original wooden shelf and nearby plant are absent.
must_haves.why: Both have been replaced by a pale countertop and a neutral kitchen background.

must_haves.item: Warm highlights on the jar are consistent with light arriving from the upper left.
must_haves.why: The bright right-side glass reflections and leftward cast shadow indicate illumination from the upper right.

must_haves.item: The candle casts a grounded shadow toward the lower right, with no contradictory original shadow.
must_haves.why: The shadow is grounded but extends prominently toward the lower left, not the lower right.

must_haves.item: Transparent glass edges show the new setting naturally rather than retaining shelf or plant fragments.
must_haves.why: The transparent rim and base integrate naturally with the new setting, without visible shelf or plant remnants.

must_haves.item: The output is square with no added text.
must_haves.why: The image is square and contains no visible text.
